title: Draft/send and overlapping command claims — measured SQL and native evidence

method.engine: PostgreSQL 14, disposable databases cloned from an empty migrated template, dropped after use; synthetic data only
method.claim: exact claim transaction (5 s lock timeout, 15 s statement timeout, provider advisory locks); window, then the per-ID acquire loop (budget 128 probes; first lease stops)
method.units: a configuration = size x statistics x case x vacuum state x provider x plan mode x first/repeat; each configuration compares 3 windows (draft ordinary, draft recovery, command)

current.drafts 64 candidates: 24 ms local compiled native test incl. separately awaited commit; 65 window+acquire logical SQL calls, 71 full Outlook transaction calls (not wire round trips)
current.commands 48 candidates: 30 ms local compiled native test incl. separately awaited commit; 49 window+acquire logical SQL calls, 55 full Outlook transaction calls (not wire round trips)

nativeMethodWall.note: measured locally by the root on the committed source; earlier 21/29 and 22/25 ms are historical

method.notClaimed: no PRODUCTION latency/throughput and no real-provider claims; no full-range growth pass from adjacent pairs alone

gate: carry of the measured matrix (acquire SQL and migrations byte-identical) + paired delta for every changed SQL statement; any unexplained paired difference would have required the full matrix at that scale

carriedMatrix.note: measured on the pre-delta source; acquire statements and all migrations are byte-identical in the committed source

absoluteBufferBudgetMisses.note: ABSOLUTE per-claim buffer budget only; all are the known idle mass-deferral first touch (dead due-index walk), reported separately, not a pass
